Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)

Required findings: Diagnosis of infection, acute traumatic fracture/dislocation, neoplastic lesion, or direct vertebral‑body compression requiring corpectomy
MRI (or CT) demonstrating pathology at the vertebral body level with neural element compression or instability; dynamic flexion/extension X‑rays if instability is assessed
Neurological deficit (e.g., myelopathy, radiculopathy) or severe, incapacitating neck pain documented on two separate exams
Failure of ≥6 weeks of documented non‑surgical management (physical therapy, analgesics, epidural steroid injections) unless the case is urgent/emergent
Verified nicotine‑free status for elective cases (objective cotinine test within 30 days) and no unmanaged major psychiatric or substance‑use disorder
All standard ACDF criteria (symptom severity, objective exam findings, concordant imaging, conservative‑therapy trial) must also be met

Non-Indications: Elective repeat ACDF or corpectomy at the same level performed <6 months after prior surgery without documented failure of conservative therapy
Absence of concordant imaging findings (no MRI/CT evidence of infection, trauma, tumor, or compression)
No neurological deficit or pain severe enough to be incapacitating
Active tobacco use without documented cessation or objective cotinine verification for non‑urgent cases
Unmanaged major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, opioid or alcohol use disorder, or other significant behavioral health condition
Pathology limited to osteophyte removal without vertebral‑body involvement
Important criteria & exceptions: Urgent/emergent presentations (e.g., acute spinal fracture with cord compression, progressive myelopathy, bowel/bladder dysfunction) waive the requirement for prior conservative therapy, smoking cessation proof, and behavioral‑health clearance
Objective cotinine testing must be performed within 30 days of the prior‑auth submission for elective cases
If the corpectomy is performed as an alternative to ACDF, all ACDF‑specific criteria must be satisfied and documented
Documentation required: Operative report of any prior cervical surgery (if repeat procedure)
Cervical MRI (with/without contrast) or CT report showing infection, fracture, tumor, or vertebral‑body compression
Dynamic flexion‑extension cervical X‑ray series demonstrating instability if indicated
Neurological examination notes documenting motor grade ≤3/5, sensory changes, or bowel/bladder dysfunction on two separate visits
Physical therapy, pain‑management, and medication records confirming ≥6 weeks of non‑surgical care (unless emergent)
Smoking cessation documentation and quantitative cotinine test result (negative)
Behavioral health evaluation note confirming no unmanaged psychiatric or substance‑use disorder
Laboratory results supporting infection (CBC, ESR/CRP) when infection is the indication
Trauma documentation (emergency department notes, mechanism of injury, imaging) when trauma is the indication
